summary: MOD ASER Register exports (CSV/Excel/PDF) and per-asset Replacement Evidence Report PDF verified end-to-end via UI + network monitoring. All 4 downloads returned HTTP 200 with correct content-types. Portal opens correctly from /pulse → Reports → red ASER card.
critical_code_review_comments: MODASERPortal.js is 789 lines — consider splitting RegisterView / DetailView / AnalyticsView into modules (>700 line threshold).
downloadBlob() catches errors silently (empty catch block) — would benefit from console.error for debug visibility.
Replacement Evidence button (line 775) re-derives token from headers via string replace — could reuse the same `token` closure variable for consistency with the other three export buttons.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 2 seeded ASER entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: login → /pulse → Reports tab → mod-reports-aser-open → portal Register view shows aser-export-group with CSV/XLSX/PDF buttons. Clicking each triggered GET /api/mod/aser/export/{csv|xlsx|pdf} → 200 with text/csv, spreadsheetml.sheet, application/pdf respectively. Opened an ASER row → aser-replacement-evidence button → GET /api/mod/aser/export/replacement-evidence/{equipment_id} → 200 application/pdf. Sonner toast DOM was not captured by selector query (transient), but downloads all succeeded — download behavior itself was proven by 200 blob responses. Non-blocking CSP console warnings for external scripts (assets.emergent.sh, posthog, cloudflareinsights) and pre-existing 403s from /api/pulse/kpis are unrelated to ASER exports.
